"Later this week, floor markings stood out in your note, and we are sorry" you were left with the feeling that our handling of your companion animal booking was clumsy and that the information you received did not match what you expected on the day of travel. I am sorry for that. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is expected to keep each journey steady and clear, and when we miss that mark, we review the case in a calm, stepwise way. I have checked the service notes, spoken with the team involved, and compared the guidance given at booking with the care plan prepared for the animal.

What I can say is that our approach is built around shared responsibility. We listen carefully when a traveler is worried, and we make sure the details of species, temperament, crate fit, handling needs, and comfort measures are considered before departure. If a traveler is told one thing and experiences another, that gap needs to be addressed directly. In cases like yours, the right next step is a supervisor review, followed by a plain explanation of what happened and what we will do differently. That review also helps us see whether the issue came from a missed handoff, unclear wording, or a service point that needs retraining.

Please know that we are taking your complaint seriously and using it to tighten the routine desk work that supports animal travel. If you are willing, send the booking reference and the best contact details again so we can complete the file review and make sure any follow-up reaches you without delay. I also recommend keeping all travel notes together for future trips, since that helps us confirm the plan and avoid confusion at check-in.

We do appreciate the chance to correct the record and improve the service for you and your companion. Companion Animal Travel Desk
